report_name: CISA Launches 2026 Critical Infrastructure Security & Resilience Month

campaigns.name: Critical Infrastructure Security and Resilience Month
campaigns.description: A nationwide awareness campaign by CISA throughout November 2026 to promote best practices for securing essential systems, with a focus on the human element and emerging threats like AI.
campaigns.objective: Raise awareness and promote best practices for securing the nation's essential systems.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: The U.S. government agency leading the Critical Infrastructure Security and Resilience Month initiative to raise awareness and promote security best practices.

identities.name: White House
identities.description: Mentioned as the source of the National Resilience Strategy, which the CISA campaign promotes alignment with.

identities.name: Nick Andersen
identities.description: Acting CISA Director quoted in the report, emphasizing the importance of resilience and planning.
